text: dsh-thinking-summary 是面向 DSH Web 的推理摘要插件：它包装聊天中的原生 assistant 步骤，在思考披露区域显示简短标题和摘要，并提供查看原始思考的切换。摘要可在步骤进行中更新，也可用于历史步骤；摘要正文还会作为可见卡片呈现。插件把单步推理文本及相关请求、工具和回答上下文交给 DSH 的 llm 服务生成摘要，默认跟随当前对话的模型路由与 DSH 语言，也可在插件设置中选择模型和语言。

dsh-thinking-summary adds per-step reasoning summaries to DSH Web chat. It shows a title and summary with a way to reveal original text. Step reasoning and related context go to DSH's llm service. It follows the conversation route and locale by default, with model and language settings.
想在聊天的思考区看到每一步的简短总结。
能不能把模型的长推理折叠成标题和几句摘要，还能随时看回原文？
I want concise summaries for each reasoning step in my DSH chat, with a way to reveal the original text.
dsh-thinking-summary 的功能「逐步推理摘要」：在聊天原生思考区显示当前或历史步骤的摘要，并用标题概括阶段。摘要生成期间显示状态，完成后摘要也会出现在步骤旁的可见卡片中。
dsh-thinking-summary 的功能「摘要模型与语言设置」：在插件详情设置中选择摘要模型，或跟随对话模型，并设定自动跟随 DSH 或指定语言。保存后设置供摘要服务读取。
dsh-thinking-summary 使用前须知：生成摘要时，浏览器会提交当前步骤的推理文本及相关用户请求、工具结果和回答上下文，服务端再交给所选 DSH 模型路由生成摘要。

[Source](https://github.com/HUSTforever/dsh-thinking-summary) · MIT · Node.js 22.19+ or 24+

Codex-style per-step reasoning summaries inside DeepSeek Harness's native thinking disclosure. A short action title replaces the raw preview; expanding shows 1–2 sentences and a switch to the original thinking. Answers, tools, images, grouping and disclosure behavior continue to use the native renderer.

dsh-thinking-summary README · dsh-thinking-summary：Version 0.2 replaces the old end-of-turn card beneath the final answer. It updates during each model step and completes the final snapshot when the step settles. It summarizes high-level actions and findings without reproducing private deliberation or claiming planned actions have succeeded.

dsh-thinking-summary README · dsh-thinking-summary：Version 0.3 packages the plugin as an installable DSH bundle: a release tarball and Git tag can be installed from the Plugins page or `dsh plugin`, without copying files into the profile. Summary behavior is unchanged from 0.2.

dsh-thinking-summary README · dsh-thinking-summary：This approximates Codex's presentation. DeepSeek still requires an auxiliary model request, so latency and generation behavior differ from OpenAI's native reasoning-summary stream. See [reasoning summaries](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/reasoning) and [streaming events](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/streaming-events).

dsh-thinking-summary README · Behavior：- First live update after approximately 1.2 seconds, with at least 40 source characters; the host additionally enforces `minReasoningChars`.
- Further live updates require 8 seconds and 600 new characters. A settled step requests its final snapshot.
- Auxiliary calls are serialized per page and identical requests are coalesced.
- The summary is also rendered as a visible process card beneath the reasoning row, so the body is readable without expanding the disclosure; the disclosure keeps the short title and can still switch to the original thinking.
- Historical rows backfill automatically once they enter or approach the viewport; scrolling fills them lazily instead of starting a whole-session batch.
- Failed summaries can be retried. Original thinking remains accessible through the official reasoning body slot, including other body presentation plugins.
- Summaries follow the DSH locale by default. Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-thinking-summary** to choose the summary model; set the language to `auto` to follow DSH or enter a tag such as `zh`, `en`, or `zh-CN`. The prompt asks for Codex's `**action heading** + 1–2 sentences` format

dsh-thinking-summary README · Install：The plugin installs as a DSH bundle: its manifest points at `cordis.patch.yml`,
so the plugin manager downloads the package, adds it to the profile's bundle
list, and applies the defaults. No file copying and no manual profile edit are
required.

Tested with Harness desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`; the package declares
`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2"`.

dsh-thinking-summary README · From the Plugins page (desktop and Web)：1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Choose **Add plugin**, then **Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Paste one of these specs:
   - Release tarball:
     `https://github.com/HUSTforever/dsh-thinking-summary/releases/download/v0.3.0/dsh-thinking-summary-0.3.0.tgz`
   - Git tag: `github:HUSTforever/dsh-thinking-summary#v0.3.0`
4. Install, then choose **Enable now** if the dialog offers it.
5. Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-thinking-summary** to pick the
   summary model and language.

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <spec>

Pass the same tarball URL or Git spec as above. The desktop profile is owned by

text:
dsh-thinking-summary README · Manual installation (development only)：To test local changes without installing the bundle, copy `package.json`,
`cordis.patch.yml`, `lib/` and the README/CHANGELOG/LICENSE files into:

```text
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-thinking-summary
```

and add the insert entry from [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) to the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Do not do this on a profile where the bundle is
already installed — the entry would be inserted twice.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Updating：Third-party bundles upgrade by removing the installed copy and installing the
newer spec; the Plugins page offers this as uninstall followed by install. Tags
give every release a stable spec, for example
`github:HUSTforever/dsh-thinking-summary#v0.3.0`.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Updating：Profile configuration can reload live. After replacing already-imported
JavaScript, refresh the page (and restart Harness if the host half changed) to
load both halves. The local port may change; check
`/dsh-thinking-summary/health` on the current port.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Plugin settings：Open **Plugins → Installed plugins → dsh-thinking-summary**, then use the **Thinking summary** section on the plugin's detail page to choose the summary provider/model (or follow the conversation route) and the language (`auto` follows DSH; `zh`, `en`, `zh-CN`, etc. override it). Settings are saved to `~/.dsh/thinking-summary/settings.json` and apply immediately.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `provider`, `model` | empty | Use the route recorded for the step; configure both as a host fallback if needed. |
| `language` | `auto` | Follow the DSH locale; overridable in the plugin settings. |
| `thinking` | `off` | Disable thinking for the auxiliary request, falling back if unsupported. |
| `maxChars` | `600` | Combined title/body character budget. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `220` | Auxiliary output token cap. |
| `minReasoningChars` | `120` | Shorter sources skip generation. |
| `maxInputChars` | `24000` | Keep the head and tail of longer inputs. |
| `timeoutMs` | `45000` | Per-generation deadline. |
| `cacheSize` | `400` | Host cache entries; `0` disables caching. |
dsh-thinking-summary README · Configuration：Durable cache: `~/.dsh/thinking-summary/cache.json`; plugin settings: `~/.dsh/thinking-summary/settings.json`. Clearing the cache does not alter sessions.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Version management：`package.json` is the single source of the version; the health route reads it when the host half loads, so a release bump never edits two places. Work lands on `main`, and every release is a semver tag:

```powershell
npm version patch --message "release: v%s"   # or minor / major
git push --follow-tags
```

dsh-thinking-summary README · Version management：`npm version` updates `package.json`, commits and creates the annotated `vX.Y.Z` tag. Push it with `git push --follow-tags`; the Release workflow then runs the checks, packs `dsh-thinking-summary-X.Y.Z.tgz` and creates the GitHub release with that tarball attached. Every release is installable from its asset URL or its Git tag. CI runs `npm run check` and `npm test` on every push and pull request.

dsh-thinking-summary README · Development：No build step or dependencies are required. The browser bundle only imports the baseline `react` module and receives Harness services through the plugin context.

```powershell
npm test
npm run check
```
